intent_summary: Acceptable ranges and maximum absolute or relative changes identify explicit criterion violations, including before calibration.

criteria.criterion: Values outside an inclusive acceptable range are violations, while values on the boundary are accepted.
Absolute and relative changes must exceed their declared maximum to violate a rule.
Relative-change checks require a nonzero previous value and do not bridge missing observations.
Violations identify the exact declared rule and remain action-ineligible unless policy explicitly permits them.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Read unit-cost stdout and drilldown: review-above-13c outside [0,0.13] is a caller-declared numerical criterion, with explicit non-claims about cause and incidents.
